pages.text: The $(item)Fluid Packet Encoder/$ creates $(item)Fluid Packets/$ filled with fluids.$(p)This machine requires power.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Fluid Packet Encoder/$, place next to a fluid container, and place a template fluid container or a fluid drop inside.$(p)You can then specify the amount of fluid the created $(item)Fluid Packet/$ should contain.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: Finally, apply a redstone signal to the machine to create the packet.$(p)The created packet will be ejected into adjacent inventories.
